items.title_en: International gold prices hit a new low in over a year. Experts: The underlying reasons are the strengthening of the U.S. dollar and rising expectations of U.S. interest rate hikes.
items.body_en: During the Asian trading session on November 20, London spot gold fell below $3,600/oz, dropping as low as around $3,514 intraday, marking its lowest point in over a year. Domestically, the Shanghai Gold Exchange saw its lowest intraday price dip to RMB 755/g. This nearly year-long rally in gold prices has recently undergone a significant correction. Analysts suggest that the renewed rise in market expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate hikes has been the direct catalyst for this correction. Zhang Zhouchi, a senior analyst at the Caitong Securities Research Institute, believes that gold has been on a downward trend since mid-October. Moreover, it is not just gold; all precious metals have experienced significant declines, with silver showing an even sharper drop.

items.title_zh: 穆迪对英国的评级
items.body_zh: AA3评级平衡了富裕、多元化的经济和强大的机构，以及温和的增长前景和充满挑战的财政前景。 与欧盟更紧密的经济合作以及人工智能带来的生产力提升，为经济增长带来了中期上行风险。 随着通胀放缓，预计债务负担能力将趋于稳定，但利息支出相对于财政收入仍将处于高位。 预计英国财政赤字将在2026年收窄至4.5%，2027年收窄至4%。 到本十年末，英国政府债务将从2025年占GDP的102%升至106%。
items.title_en: Moody's rating of the UK.
items.body_en: The AA3 rating balances a wealthy, diversified economy and strong institutions with a moderate growth outlook and challenging fiscal prospects. Closer economic cooperation with the EU and productivity gains from artificial intelligence present medium-term upside risks to economic growth. As inflation slows, debt sustainability is expected to stabilize, but interest expenditure will remain high relative to fiscal revenue. The UK's fiscal deficit is expected to narrow to 4.5% in 2026 and 4% in 2027. By the end of this decade, U.K. government debt will rise from 102% of GDP in 2025 to 106%.

items.title_en: European stock markets experience their largest weekly decline since 2025, with tech stocks taking a significant hit.

The STOXX Europe 600 Index closed down 2%, bringing its cumulative decline for the week to 5.8%. The technology sector index plummeted by 11% this week, marking its largest weekly decline since March 2020. As copper and gold prices fell, mining stocks also declined. Investors have shifted to buying more defensive sectors such as personal care, food, and healthcare.

items.title_en: Report: Retail investor demand for Anthropic's IPO reaches $120 billion, surpassing SpaceX.
items.body_en: According to sources, Anthropic PBC's initial public offering (IPO) attracted approximately $115 billion to $120 billion in subscription demand from retail investors, surpassing the amount subscribed by retail investors when SpaceX went public. The IPO of this cutting-edge AI lab attracted over $500 billion in subscription demand from institutional investors, more than double the amount of institutional subscriptions for SpaceX. Anthropic's IPO was the largest in history, with the company and its seven co-founders raising $935 billion through the IPO, including the over-allotment portion, easily surpassing SpaceX's $862 billion.

story.title_zh: 最自信的一年，他差点赔光一切
story.title_en: The Year of Total Confidence Nearly Ruined Him
story.body_zh: 一九八二年，达利欧公开判断美国经济将走向萧条并重仓押注。结果墨西哥违约后市场不跌反涨，公司只剩他一个人。他从此写下每笔决策的依据，把痛苦变成算法，后来的桥水成了全球最大对冲基金。
story.body_en: In nineteen eighty-two, Ray Dalio predicted a depression, loudly and publicly. Then Mexico defaulted, and markets rose instead of falling. His company shrank to one person: himself. From then on, he logged every decision. Pain became an algorithm. That log built Bridgewater, the largest hedge fund in the world.

lines.en: Nineteen eighty-two. A young trader goes on television, and says the word everyone fears. Depression.
lines.zh: 1982 年。一个年轻交易员上电视，说出了所有人害怕的那个词：萧条。

lines.en: I am completely certain. The economy is going down. I have bet everything on it.
lines.zh: 我非常确定，经济要往下走。我把全部身家都押上了。

lines.en: Then Mexico defaulted. And the market did the one thing he did not expect. It rose.
lines.zh: 然后，墨西哥违约了。市场做了他唯一没料到的事：上涨。

lines.en: Ray, you have to close the company. You have lost everything.
lines.zh: 瑞，你得把公司关了，你什么都赔光了。

lines.en: I have four thousand dollars left, borrowed from my father. And one employee. Me.
lines.zh: 我还剩向我爸借的四千美元，和一个员工——我自己。

lines.en: He later called it the most valuable event of his life. From then on, he wrote down the reason behind every decision. Every mistake was logged and studied. Pain became an algorithm.
lines.zh: 他后来称这次经历是一生中最宝贵的。从那以后，他把每个决策的依据都写下来，每个错误都记录归档。痛苦，变成了算法。

joke.title_zh: 邻居失业叫衰退，自己失业叫萧条
joke.title_en: A Recession Is When Your Neighbor Loses His Job
joke.body_zh: 据说杜鲁门总统这样区分经济术语：邻居失业，叫衰退；自己失业，才叫萧条。一句话戳破了宏大叙事——经济数据再漂亮，落到每个具体的人身上，感受是完全不同的。这也提醒我们读新闻时留个心眼：报表上的百分比，都是别人的人生。理解经济，要从理解一个具体的人开始。
joke.body_en: President Truman supposedly explained economic terms this way. A recession is when your neighbor loses his job. A depression is when you lose yours. One sentence, and all the big words collapse. Growth rates look beautiful on paper. But every percentage point is somebody's real life. It is a good habit when reading the news. Behind every statistic, there is a person. Economics starts with people, not charts.

story.title_zh: 省下一滴焊料的人，成了首富
story.title_en: The Man Who Saved One Drop of Solder
story.body_zh: 洛克菲勒参观自家炼油厂，问工人焊一个油桶用几滴焊料。答：四十滴。他让人试试三十八滴，一滴不漏。就为这两滴，工厂每年省下大笔钱。他说：巨大的财富，就是对小事的巨大认真。
story.body_en: Young Rockefeller once watched workers seal oil barrels. He asked how many drops of solder each barrel took. Forty, they said. He asked them to try thirty-eight. Not a single barrel leaked. His ledgers went to three decimal places. Great wealth comes from great attention to small things.

lines.en: Ohio, eighteen seventy. A quiet man in a dark suit is watching workers seal oil barrels, one by one.
lines.zh: 俄亥俄，1870 年。一个穿黑西装的安静男人，正看着工人们一个一个焊接油桶。

lines.en: How many drops of solder does one barrel take?
lines.zh: 焊一个桶，要用几滴焊料？

lines.en: Forty drops, sir. Same as always.
lines.zh: 四十滴，先生。一直都是四十滴。

lines.en: Try thirty-eight.
lines.zh: 试试三十八滴。

lines.en: They tried. Not a single barrel leaked. Those two drops saved the plant real money, every single year.
lines.zh: 工人们试了。一滴都没漏。就这两滴，每年给工厂省下真金白银。

lines.en: Great wealth comes from great attention to small things. Saved one drop at a time.
lines.zh: 巨大的财富，就是对小事的巨大认真，一滴一滴攒出来的。

joke.title_zh: 银行家为什么辞职？他失去了“利息”

joke.body_zh: 一位年轻银行家在大银行干满一年就辞职了。朋友都问他为什么，他只说了一句：我失去了利息。这个笑话妙在双关。英文里利息和兴趣是同一个词。对银行家来说，这两样东西缺一样都干不下去。所以下次见到闷闷不乐的银行家，你可以关心地问一句：是利息的问题，还是兴趣的问题？
joke.body_en: A young banker worked at a big bank for exactly one year. Then he quit. His friends all asked why. He gave them a one line answer. I lost interest. The joke works in two ways. In English, the money a bank pays you, and the feeling of caring, are the same word. A banker cannot survive without either one. So next time you meet a sad banker, ask politely. Is it the interest, or the interest?

items.title_en: Federal Reserve Meeting Minutes: Two officials stated that a December rate hike exceeding 25 basis points is warranted, and nearly all participants believe that further action may be appropriate.
items.body_en: The Federal Reserve's meeting minutes indicate that almost all participants in the Federal Reserve's October 27–28 meeting believed that further interest rate hikes, largely in line with policymakers' September projections, might be appropriate. Most participants expressed support for not raising interest rates at the October meeting. A few participants noted that if subsequent inflation data were unfavorable, the December meeting could consider raising interest rates by more than 25 basis points. A few participants believed that inflation might be more persistent than expected, making it necessary to shift to a more restrictive policy stance. Some participants supported a 25-basis-point rate hike at the October meeting, emphasizing that inflation was too high and showed almost no signs of easing.

items.title_zh: 科学家利用量子纠缠特性首次完成位置验证
items.body_zh: 美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）等机构研究团队18日在《自然》杂志在线发表研究成果，首次完整演示了一种量子位置验证协议。实验表明，利用量子纠缠等特性，可以确认他是否确实身处该地。这为防止远程身份欺诈提供新思路，不过，要将这项技术投入实际应用可能还需十年以上。（科技日报）
items.title_en: Scientists use quantum entanglement to complete position verification for the first time.
items.body_en: On the 18th, research teams from institutions such as the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) published their findings online in the journal Nature, presenting for the first time a complete demonstration of a quantum location verification protocol. The experiment showed that by utilizing properties such as quantum entanglement, it is possible to confirm whether a person is actually present at a certain location. This provides a new approach to preventing remote identity fraud. However, it may take more than a decade to put this technology into practical use. (Science and Technology Daily).

items.title_zh: 赛诺菲口服药venglustat成为首款获美国批准用于治疗罕见神经系统疾病的药物
items.body_zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）周三批准了赛诺菲旗下公司的口服药物文格鲁斯塔特（venglustat），该监管机构表示，这使其成为首款用于治疗一种 影响大脑和神经系统的罕见遗传性疾病的 药物。 该药物商品名为Infilbray ，获批用于治疗第3型戈谢病——这是一种神经系统变异型疾病，会导致某些脂肪物质在器官和组织中积聚。
items.title_en: Sanofi's oral drug venglustat becomes the first drug approved in the United States for the treatment of a rare neurological disorder.
items.body_en: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved venglustat, an oral drug from a Sanofi subsidiary, on Wednesday. The regulatory agency stated that this makes it the first drug to treat a rare genetic disorder that affects the brain and nervous system. The drug, marketed under the name Infilbray, has been approved for the treatment of Gaucher disease type 3, a neurovisceral variant of the disease that causes certain fatty substances to accumulate in organs and tissues.

story.title_zh: 把银行家锁进书房，直到他们答应救市
story.title_en: The Night He Locked the Bankers In
story.body_zh: 一九〇七年十月纽约股市崩盘，没有央行兜底的美国眼看滑向恐慌。六十九岁的摩根把几十位银行总裁锁进书房，逼出两千五百万美元救市资金，凌晨签下协议，恐慌停了。五年后美联储成立。
story.body_en: In October nineteen oh seven, New York was in panic. America had no central bank. J.P. Morgan, sixty-nine years old, summoned bank presidents to his library and locked the doors. The deal was signed after midnight. The panic stopped. Five years later, the Federal Reserve was born.

lines.en: New York, October, nineteen oh seven. Depositors are lining up in the streets. America has no central bank, and the panic is spreading.
lines.zh: 纽约，1907 年 10 月。储户在街头排起长队。美国没有央行，恐慌正在蔓延。

lines.en: So the most powerful banker in America did something nobody would dare today.
lines.zh: 于是，全美最有权势的银行家做了一件今天没人敢做的事。

lines.en: Gentlemen, you will all come to my library tonight. Bring your real numbers, not the ones for newspapers.
lines.zh: 诸位，今晚都到我的书房来。带上真实的账目，别带给报纸看的那份。

lines.en: He questioned each president one by one, behind closed doors, until the true holes were on the table.
lines.zh: 他关门一个个逼问各位总裁，直到真实的窟窿全部摆上桌面。

lines.en: It is almost twelve o'clock. Nobody leaves this room until the papers are signed.
lines.zh: 现在快十二点了。文件不签完，谁也别想出这个门。

lines.en: After midnight, twenty-five million dollars was pledged. The panic stopped. Five years later, partly because of this night, the Federal Reserve was born.
lines.zh: 午夜过后，两千五百万美元的救市资金凑齐了。恐慌停了。五年后，正因为这一夜，美联储诞生了。

joke.title_zh: 杯子半满？工程师说杯子太大了
joke.title_en: Half Full? The Engineer Says the Glass Is Too Big
joke.body_zh: 乐观主义者说杯子是半满的，悲观主义者说是半空的，工程师看了看说：这个杯子比实际需要的大了一倍。放到市场里也一样：同一个行情，多头看到机会，空头看到风险，而真正干活的人只关心一件事——估值和实际价值差多少。别急着站队，先量一量杯子。
joke.body_en: The optimist says the glass is half full. The pessimist says it is half empty. The engineer looks at both and says, the glass is twice as big as it needs to be. Markets work the same way. The bull sees opportunity. The bear sees risk. The person doing the actual work asks only one question. How far is the price from the real value? Do not rush to pick a side. First, measure the glass.

story.title_zh: 一夜之间，与英格兰银行对赌的人
story.title_en: The Night He Bet Against the Bank of England
story.body_zh: 一九九二年，英镑被固定汇率锁在偏高的位置。索罗斯判断英国撑不住。九月十六日英国一天加息两次仍挡不住卖盘，当晚英镑暴跌。他的基金净赚约十亿美元，报纸标题写着打垮了英格兰银行。
story.body_en: In nineteen ninety-two, the British pound was locked into a fixed exchange rate that was too high. On September sixteenth, Britain raised rates twice in one day. It was not enough. That evening, the pound crashed. His fund made about one billion dollars.

lines.en: London, September, nineteen ninety-two. Black Wednesday is only hours away.
lines.zh: 伦敦，1992 年 9 月。距离黑色星期三，只剩几个小时了。

lines.en: George, the Bank of England keeps defending the pound. Rates went up again this morning.
lines.zh: 乔治，英格兰银行还在死守英镑，今天上午又加息了。

lines.en: A weak economy cannot defend an overvalued currency forever. Increase the position.
lines.zh: 疲软的经济，守不住高估的货币。继续加仓。

lines.en: All of it? This is the Bank of England we are betting against.
lines.zh: 全部押上？我们赌的对手可是英格兰银行。

lines.en: When a trade is right, go for the jugular.
lines.zh: 当一笔交易是对的，就要直取要害。

lines.en: That evening Britain gave up, and the pound crashed out of the system. His fund made about one billion dollars. Newspapers said he broke the Bank of England.
lines.zh: 当晚，英国投降了，英镑暴跌退出汇率机制。他的基金净赚约十亿美元。报纸标题写着：他打垮了英格兰银行。

joke.title_zh: 擦鞋童都在荐股的那天，他清仓离场
joke.title_en: When the Shoeshine Boy Gave Stock Tips
joke.body_zh: 一九二九年，约瑟夫·肯尼迪让擦鞋童擦鞋，小孩却热心地给他推荐起股票来。他回到办公室立刻清仓。他的逻辑是：连擦鞋童都在荐股，说明最后一批买家已经进场，接下来只有卖盘了。没过多久，大崩盘来了。这个观察后来被称为擦鞋童理论：当所有人都在谈论某样东西时，往往意味着它已经不便宜了。
joke.body_en: New York, nineteen twenty-nine. Joseph Kennedy got his shoes polished, and the shoeshine boy happily gave him stock tips. Kennedy walked back to his office and sold everything. His logic was sharp. If the shoeshine boy is giving stock tips, the last buyers have already arrived. Who is left to buy? Soon after, the market crashed. People still call it the shoeshine boy theory. When everybody talks about something, it is usually no longer cheap.

items.title_zh: 美联储理事Barr称AI智能体或加大未来银行挤兑风险
items.body_zh: 美联储理事Michael Barr警告称，自主AI智能体可能会根据市场信号或利率变化自动转移客户存款，从而加大银行挤兑风险。Barr周一在米兰举行的一次会议上发表讲话时指出，大型银行已经发现有AI智能体试图在零售账户中执行未经授权的操作。过去客户需要亲自执行转账操作，而现在AI智能体能够立即检测到收益率差异或市场波动信号，并自主高速转移资金，这可能会加速几分钟内发生的挤兑，使传统的流动性管理和监管干预时限难以招架。
items.title_en: Federal Reserve Governor Barr says AI agents could increase the risk of future bank runs.
items.body_en: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr has warned that autonomous AI agents could automatically transfer customer deposits based on market signals or interest rate changes, thereby increasing the risk of bank runs. Speaking at a conference in Milan on Monday, Barr noted that large banks have already detected AI agents attempting to perform unauthorized actions in retail accounts. In the past, customers had to personally execute transfer operations. Now, AI agents can instantly detect yield differentials or signals of market volatility and autonomously transfer funds at high speed. This could accelerate bank runs within minutes, making traditional liquidity management and regulatory intervention timelines difficult to cope with.

story.title_zh: 从每周一美元二毛，到钢铁大王
story.title_en: From a Dollar Twenty a Week to Steel
story.body_zh: 卡内基十三岁移民美国，第一份工每周挣一美元二毛。当电报信童时，他背下全城商户的名字和脸。二十几岁把全部身家压进钢铁，建成世界最大钢铁厂。晚年捐出九成财产。
story.body_en: Andrew Carnegie arrived in America from Scotland at thirteen. His first job paid one dollar and twenty cents a week. As a messenger boy, he memorized every business in town. In his thirties he bet everything on steel, built the largest steel company in the world, then gave away ninety percent of it.

lines.en: Pittsburgh, eighteen fifty. A thirteen year old Scottish immigrant starts his first job. It pays one dollar and twenty cents a week.
lines.zh: 匹兹堡，1850 年。一个十三岁的苏格兰移民开始第一份工作，周薪一美元二毛。

lines.en: Boy, the telegraph office needs a messenger. Can you learn the streets?
lines.zh: 小子，电报局要个信童。你能把街巷记熟吗？

lines.en: I will learn more than the streets, sir. I will learn every business in town, and every face behind the door.
lines.zh: 先生，我记的不只是街巷。我要记住全城每一家商户，和每扇门后面的每张脸。

lines.en: While other boys played, he drilled himself on the telegraph key, and became the fastest ear in the city.
lines.zh: 别的孩子去玩了，他对着电报机日夜苦练，成了全城收发电报最快的人。

lines.en: Save it, invest it early, and when you find your industry, bet everything on it.
lines.zh: 把钱存下来，早一点投出去。找到属于自己的行业时，就把全部身家押上去。

lines.en: He built the largest steel company in the world. Then he gave ninety percent of it away, with one line for the history books. Dying rich is a disgrace.
lines.zh: 他建成了世界最大的钢铁公司，然后捐出了九成财产，只留给历史一句话：带着巨富死去，是一种耻辱。

joke.title_zh: 我是靠卖得太早赚的钱
joke.title_en: I Made My Fortune by Selling Too Early
joke.body_zh: 罗斯柴尔德家族的男爵说过一句反直觉的话：我是靠卖得太早，才赚到钱的。人人都怕卖早了少赚，可他偏偏说卖早是美德。背后的道理是：没人能卖在最高点，总想赚最后一分钱的人，往往连本带利还回去。留给读者一个问题：你手里的盈利，是因为贪心多等了几天，还是因为纪律提前落袋？
joke.body_en: Baron Rothschild said something that sounds backwards. I made my fortune by selling too early. Everyone fears selling too soon and missing the top. He called selling early a virtue. The logic is simple. Nobody sells at the exact peak. People who chase the last penny usually return everything, and more. So here is a question worth thinking about. Your last winning trade. Did you hold longer out of greed, or exit early out of discipline?

items.title_zh: 10月末社融、M2增速均超7% 专家：年内降息降准可能性下降
items.body_zh: 中国人民银行公布2026年10月金融数据。10月末，社会融资规模存量为469.16万亿元，同比增长7.2%；广义货币（M2）余额359.06万亿元，同比增长7.1%。两项指标均高于名义GDP增速，同经济增长、价格总水平预期目标相匹配。
items.title_en: At the end of October, both total social financing and M2 growth exceeded 7%. Expert: The likelihood of interest rate cuts and RRR cuts within the year has decreased.
items.body_en: The People's Bank of China released financial data for October 2026. At the end of October, the outstanding total social financing (TSF) stood at RMB 469.16 trillion, up 7.2% year-on-year; the broad money supply (M2) balance was RMB 359.06 trillion, up 7.1% year-on-year. Both indicators are higher than the nominal GDP growth rate and are consistent with the expected targets for economic growth and the general price level.

items.title_zh: 三星将在美国生产SpaceX卫星芯片
items.body_zh: 三星电子将扩建位于得克萨斯州奥斯汀的芯片工厂，为马斯克旗下太空企业SpaceX生产星链卫星搭载的STM32V8微控制器（MCU）。三星已经在得州布局晶圆代工基地，如今在原有客户（特斯拉、英伟达、AMD的AI芯片订单）之外新增SpaceX卫星芯片业务，其美国业务版图正快速拓展至航天与国防领域。
items.title_en: Samsung to Manufacture SpaceX Satellite Chips in the United States.
items.body_en: Samsung Electronics will expand its chip factory in Austin, Texas, to produce the STM32V8 microcontrollers (MCUs) used in SpaceX's Starlink satellites. Samsung has already established a wafer foundry base in Texas. Now, in addition to its existing customers (AI chip orders from Tesla, Nvidia, and AMD), it has added SpaceX's satellite chip business. Its U.S. business footprint is rapidly expanding into the aerospace and defense sectors.

Bassett suggested that Nvidia should look outside the company for a new leader. (The ousted) Jensen Huang is a remarkable innovator, and Nvidia is an outstanding company. items.title_zh: 美国堪萨斯城联储主席：美联储在降低通胀方面还有更多工作要做
items.body_zh: 美国堪萨斯城联储主席Jeff Schmid表示，通胀仍然过热，决策者还有更多工作要做。他周日在为夏威夷一场会议准备的讲稿中表示，正如美联储主席凯文·沃什8月所说，“美联储在通胀问题上还有一些工作要做，不幸的是，自那以来，我们的工作变得更加艰难。”美联储偏爱的价格指标9月同比上涨3.6%，Schmid称这一水平“令人不安地”高于央行2%的目标，而且“朝着错误的方向发展”。
items.title_en: President of the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City: The Federal Reserve has more work to do to reduce inflation.
items.body_en: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City President Jeff Schmid stated that inflation remains overheated, and policymakers still have more work to do. In his speech prepared for a conference in Hawaii on Sunday, he stated, as Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said in August, "The Federal Reserve still has some work to do on inflation, and unfortunately, our task has become even more challenging since then." The Federal Reserve's preferred price index rose by 3.6% year-over-year in September. Schmid described this level as "disturbingly" higher than the Federal Reserve's 2% target and "moving in the wrong direction."

items.title_en: Li Qiang Arrives in Manila to Attend the China–ASEAN Leaders' Meeting.
items.body_en: At the invitation of President Marcos of the Philippines, the rotating chair of ASEAN, Premier Li Qiang of the State Council arrived at Ninoy Aquino International Airport in Manila on the evening of November 15 on a chartered flight to attend the China–ASEAN Leaders' Meeting. Philippine Secretary of Finance Ralph Recto, Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Huang Xilian, and Chinese Ambassador to ASEAN Wang Qingtian were among those who greeted him at the airport. Li Qiang traveled to Manila after concluding his official visit to Thailand. Upon his departure from Bangkok, Thai Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance Pichai Chunhavajira, along with Chinese Ambassador to Thailand Han Jianwei, were present at the airport to see him off. (Xinhua News Agency).

items.title_zh: 美联储副主席Jefferson：通胀将决定利率决策
items.body_zh: 美联储副主席Philip Jefferson表示，在考虑进一步加息时，通胀已成为政策制定者最重要的衡量指标。近期美国经济活动和劳动力市场状况一直稳健，但价格压力依然顽固，10月份的物价数据与远高于目标的通胀水平相一致。货币政策可以影响周期性状况，但无法解决决定长期就业率的结构性因素，例如工人技能与雇主需求之间的错配。
items.title_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Jefferson: Inflation will determine interest rate decisions.
items.body_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson stated that inflation has become the most important metric for policymakers when considering further interest rate hikes. Recently, U.S. economic activity and labor market conditions have remained robust, but price pressures persist. October's price data aligns with inflation levels well above the target. Monetary policy can influence cyclical conditions, but it cannot address the structural factors that determine long-term employment rates, such as the mismatch between workers' skills and employers' needs.

items.title_zh: 两年期美债收益率本周涨33个基点，美联储12月加息基本锁定，市场焦点转向明年1月
items.body_zh: 周五（11月13日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率涨0.81个基点，报5.1352%，本周累计上涨27.78个基点，整体持续走高，交投于4.8287%-5.1718%区间。 两年期美债收益率跌3.95个基点，报4.8419%，本周累涨33.04个基点，交投于4.5009%-4.8886%区间。
items.title_en: The yield on two-year U.S. Treasury bonds rose by 33 basis points this week, with a December rate hike by the Federal Reserve essentially confirmed. The market's focus has now shifted to January next year.
items.body_en: At the close of trading in New York on Friday (November 13), the U.S. 10-year benchmark Treasury yields rose by 0.81 basis points to 5.1352%. They have risen by a cumulative 27.78 basis points this week, continuing their overall upward trend, trading within the range of 4.8287%–5.1718%. The two-year U.S. Treasury yield fell by 3.95 basis points to 4.8419%, with a cumulative increase of 33.04 basis points this week, trading within the range of 4.5009%-4.8886%.

items.title_zh: 英特尔股价暴跌29%后遭股东起诉
items.body_zh: 英特尔遭到股东起诉，这些股东指控这家美国芯片制造商通过隐瞒个人电脑销售长期放缓的影响来欺诈他们，导致其股价单日暴跌近29%。在周五提交至加利福尼亚州圣何塞联邦法院的一份拟议集体诉讼中，由密歇根州一家养老基金领衔的股东们称，英特尔在披露个人电脑销量放缓和库存过剩将如何拖累营收方面反应迟缓。
items.title_en: Intel sued by shareholders after its share price plummeted by 29%.
items.body_en: Intel has been sued by shareholders who accuse the U.S. chipmaker of defrauding them by concealing the impact of a prolonged slowdown in PC sales, causing its share price to plummet nearly 29% in a single day. In a proposed class-action lawsuit filed on Friday in federal court in San Jose, California, shareholders led by a Michigan pension fund alleged that Intel was slow to disclose how the slowdown in PC sales and excess inventory would weigh on revenue.

items.title_zh: 一线调研培育钻石产业：毛坯价格上涨与终端饰品打折并行
items.body_zh: 近期，国际金价出现较为明显的回调，黄金珠宝零售市场迎来促销窗口，多家主流黄金品牌加大优惠力度，推出克减、满减、折扣等多种活动，优惠力度较平日明显放大。记者调研发现，随着金价回落，钻石饰品折扣力度较大，一些品牌钻石类产品5折起步，其中既包括天然钻石也包括培育钻石。与此同时，培育钻石毛坯出现涨价苗头。
items.title_en: Frontline Research on the Lab-Grown Diamond Industry: Rising Rough Diamond Prices and Simultaneous Discounts on Finished Jewelry.
items.body_en: Recently, international gold prices have experienced a relatively significant pullback, opening up a window of opportunity for promotions in the gold and jewelry retail market. Several major gold brands have intensified their promotional efforts, launching various campaigns such as price reductions per gram, discounts for reaching certain spending thresholds, and other special offers. The scale of these promotions is notably larger than usual. Our investigation revealed that, as gold prices have declined, diamond jewelry has seen significant discounts. Some brands are offering diamond products at 50% off or more, including both natural and lab-grown diamonds. At the same time, there are signs of price increases for rough lab-grown diamonds.

items.title_zh: 报道：黄仁勋与盟友讨论重返英伟达担任CEO
items.body_zh: 英国金融时报援引多位知情人士报道称，黄仁勋正考虑重返英伟达担任首席执行官。黄仁勋在硅谷的盟友正在向英伟达董事会施压，要求恢复他的职务。黄仁勋盟友表示，他们正在组建一个由硅谷企业高管组成的“战情室”，以游说推动黄仁勋重返公司，并将努力争取白宫方面的支持。 英伟达暗盘出现V形走势，目前大致持平，北京时间23:19曾跌超2%——美国总统特朗普的财长声称英伟达需要“剧烈重组”。
items.title_en: Report: Jensen Huang discusses returning to Nvidia as CEO with allies.
items.body_en: The Financial Times, citing multiple sources, reported that Jensen Huang is considering returning to Nvidia as CEO. Jensen Huang's allies in Silicon Valley are pressuring Nvidia's board of directors to reinstate him. Huang's allies said they are forming a "war room" of Silicon Valley business executives to lobby for Huang's return to the company and will work to secure support from the White House. Nvidia's after-hours trading showed a V-shaped trend and is currently roughly flat. At 23:19 Beijing time, it had fallen by more than 2% — U.S. President Trump's Treasury Secretary claimed that Nvidia needs a "radical restructuring."

items.title_zh: 美国交通部长点名军工承包商L3Harris，怀疑其造成最近的全美航班中断
items.body_zh: 近日，美国交通部长肖恩·达菲表示，官员们正在调查航空航天和国防承包商L3Harris Technologies Inc.是否对空中交通管制系统瘫痪负有责任。此次故障导致全美航班停飞超过四个小时。L3Harris上周五在美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）的一个偏远站点将一条铜线更换为光纤时，一台路由器每四到五秒就向其他路由器发起超过1,000次连接请求，导致与飞机的通信以及部分雷达数据传输受到干扰。
items.title_en: The U.S. Secretary of Transportation singled out military contractor L3Harris, suspecting it of causing the recent nationwide flight disruptions.
items.body_en: Recently, U.S. Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy stated that officials are investigating aerospace and defense contractor L3Harris Technologies Inc.for its possible responsibility in the air traffic control system outage. This malfunction led to the grounding of flights across the United States for over four hours. When L3Harris replaced a copper wire with a fiber-optic cable at a remote Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) site last Friday, a router sent over 1,000 connection requests to other routers every four to five seconds, disrupting communications with aircraft and the transmission of some radar data.

items.title_zh: 国泰海通资管澄清网传不实信息：从未曾以私募基金作为交易对手开展交易
items.body_zh: 网络近日流传有关“某机构资金委托某公司投顾管理、与私募基金开展协议式回购并发生回购违约”等传言。对此，国泰海通资管11月14日发布公告澄清称，该网传内容与上海国泰海通证券资产管理有限公司无关，网传业务并非国泰海通资管开展。
items.title_en: Cathay Haitong Asset Management clarifies false information circulating online: It has never engaged in transactions with private equity funds as counterparties.
items.body_en: Recently, rumors have been circulating online about "an institution entrusting its funds to a certain company for investment advisory management, conducting an agreed share buyback with a private equity fund, and a default occurring in the share buyback." In response, Guotai Haitong Asset Management issued an announcement on November 14, clarifying that the content circulating online is unrelated to Shanghai Guotai Haitong Securities Asset Management Co., Ltd., and that the business mentioned online is not conducted by Guotai Haitong Asset Management.

items.title_zh: 2/10年期德债收益率利差短暂“转负”！本周均至少涨超12个基点
items.body_zh: 周五（11月13日）欧市尾盘，德国10年期国债收益率涨3.0个基点，报3.377%，本周累计上涨12.2个基点，11月9-10日大部分时间持稳——10日北京时间22:00微跌至3.20%，随后持续上扬，13日发布美国PPI通胀数据时达到3.390%，本周累计上涨12.2个基点。
items.title_en: The yield spread between 2-year and 10-year German government bonds briefly "turned negative"! This week, they have all risen by at least 12 basis points.
items.body_en: At the close of European trading hours on Friday (November 13), the German 10-year Treasury yield rose by 3.0 basis points to 3.377%. It rose by a cumulative 12.2 basis points this week, remaining stable for most of November 9–10. On November 10, at 22:00 Beijing time, it edged down to 3.20% and then continued to rise, reaching 3.390% when the U.S. PPI inflation data was released on November 13. It rose by a cumulative 12.2 basis points this week.

items.title_zh: 高盛预计2027年日本以外亚洲股市回报率将达19%
items.body_zh: 高盛集团预计，尽管人工智能（AI）领域的不确定性可能加剧市场波动，但企业盈利增长仍将推动MSCI日本以外亚洲指数（MSCI Asia ex-Japan Index）明年以美元计价实现19%的回报率。该行将中国H股和印度股市的评级上调至“超配”，维持对韩国和日本股市的“超配”观点。
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs expects returns of 19% from Asian stock markets outside Japan in 2027.
items.body_en: Goldman Sachs Group expects that, although uncertainties in the field of artificial intelligence (AI) may exacerbate market volatility, corporate earnings growth will still drive the MSCI Asia ex-Japan Index to achieve a 19% return in U.S. dollar terms next year. The bank upgraded its ratings for Chinese H-shares and Indian equities to "overweight" and maintained its "overweight" stance on South Korean and Japanese equities.

items.title_zh: 北京15日正式供暖
items.body_zh: 11月15日，北京地区将正式供暖。随着供暖季的临近，国网北京市电力公司全力落实度冬供电保障重点举措。国网北京电力调度控制中心预测，今冬北京电网最大负荷可达2900万千瓦，预计较冬季历史最大负荷增长约8.29%。（北京日报）
items.title_en: Beijing's official heating starts on the 15th.
items.body_en: On November 15, heating will officially begin in the Beijing area. With the heating season approaching, State Grid Beijing Electric Power Company is making every effort to implement key measures to ensure power supply during the winter. The State Grid Beijing Electric Power Dispatching and Control Center forecasts that Beijing's power grid will reach a maximum load of 29 million kilowatts this winter, an expected increase of approximately 8.29% compared to the historical winter peak load. (Beijing Daily).

story.title_zh: 不读财报的调研法：去和对手闲聊
story.body_zh: 费雪调研公司有个怪招：不急着看报表，先去闲聊。找离职员工、供应商、同行工程师，一家公司的真实成色就浮出来了。他管这叫闲聊法，靠它拿了摩托罗拉十多年。
story.body_en: Philip Fisher had an odd way to research a company. Before reading reports, he went out and chatted. Former employees, salesmen, suppliers, rival engineers. From these talks, the truth surfaced. He called it the scuttlebutt method.

lines.en: California, nineteen fifty. While other analysts read annual reports, Philip Fisher does something strange. He goes out for coffee, and small talk.
lines.zh: 加州，1950 年。别的分析师在读年报，菲利普·费雪却在干一件怪事：出门喝咖啡、闲聊。

lines.en: You used to work at their plant. Was the new product real quality, or just a good story?
lines.zh: 你以前在他们的厂里干过。新品是真有实力，还是故事讲得好？

lines.en: Honestly? The lab is serious. But the boss loses his temper, and good people keep leaving.
lines.zh: 说实话？实验室是认真的。但老板脾气大，能干的人一直在走。

lines.en: And the competitors say the same thing, from the other side. Now the picture is complete.
lines.zh: 竞争对手从另一头说出来的，也是同样的话。拼图这就完整了。

lines.en: He called it the scuttlebutt method. It led him to hold Motorola for decades. His advice shaped Buffett too. If it is a wonderful company, almost never sell.
lines.zh: 他管这叫闲聊法。靠它，他拿住了摩托罗拉十多年。这条建议也影响了巴菲特：真正的好公司，几乎永远别卖。

joke.title_zh: 过去五次衰退，经济学家预测中了九次
joke.title_en: Nine of the Last Five Recessions
joke.body_zh: 经济学家萨缪尔森讲过一个流传至今的玩笑：股市在过去五次衰退里，预测中了九次。意思是股市总在喊狼来了，喊的次数远比狼真的来的次数多。所以听到谁信誓旦旦地预测崩盘，不用太紧张，也不用太得意，先数一数他之前喊过几次。预测市场这件事，连最聪明的人也常常只是运气好。
joke.body_en: The economist Paul Samuelson left us a joke that never gets old. The stock market has predicted nine of the last five recessions. Read that again. Nine predictions. Five real recessions. The market cries wolf far more often than the wolf arrives. So when someone loudly predicts the next crash, stay calm. Count how many times they called it before. Predicting the market is hard. Even for the smartest people in the room.

items.title_zh: 10月末社融、M2增速均超7% 专家：年内降息降准可能性下降
items.body_zh: 中国人民银行公布2026年10月金融数据。10月末，社会融资规模存量为469.16万亿元，同比增长7.2%；广义货币（M2）余额359.06万亿元，同比增长7.1%。两项指标均高于名义GDP增速，同经济增长、价格总水平预期目标相匹配。
items.title_en: At the end of October, both total social financing and M2 growth exceeded 7%. Expert: The likelihood of interest rate cuts and RRR cuts within the year has decreased.
items.body_en: The People's Bank of China released financial data for October 2026. At the end of October, the outstanding total social financing (TSF) stood at RMB 469.16 trillion, up 7.2% year-on-year; the broad money supply (M2) balance was RMB 359.06 trillion, up 7.1% year-on-year. Both indicators are higher than the nominal GDP growth rate and are consistent with the expected targets for economic growth and the general price level.

items.title_zh: 中国央行：11月16日将开展2000亿元买断式逆回购操作 期限为6个月
items.body_zh: 中国人民银行公告，2026年11月16日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展2000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为6个月（180天），到期日为2027年5月15日（遇节假日顺延）。
items.title_en: China's PBOC: A RMB 200 billion outright reverse share buyback operation will be conducted on November 16, with a term of 6 months.
items.body_en: The People's Bank of China announced that on November 16, 2026, it will conduct a RMB 200 billion outright reverse share buyback operation with a fixed amount, interest rate tender, and multiple price levels. The term of the operation is 6 months (180 days), with a maturity date of May 15, 2027 (extended if it falls on a public holiday).

items.title_zh: 美联储警示：AI推升资产估值过高带来潜在风险
items.body_zh: 美联储发布半年度金融稳定报告。报告指出，人工智能（AI）和过高的资产估值可能引发潜在脆弱性。 “资产估值压力持续处于高位。股票估值指标一直居高不下，部分原因是市场对‘超级智能’（super intelligence）的狂热，”美联储在报告中使用了美国总统特朗普对AI的偏好称呼。该央行补充称，这种狂热情绪已因市场对企业资本支出和债务发行计划的担忧而有所降温。
items.title_en: Federal Reserve Warning: AI-Driven Overvaluation of Assets Poses Potential Risks.
items.body_en: The Federal Reserve released its semi-annual Financial Stability Report. The report points out that artificial intelligence (AI) and excessively high asset valuations could lead to potential vulnerabilities. “Asset valuation pressures remain elevated. Stock valuation indicators have remained high, partly due to market enthusiasm for "super intelligence," the Federal Reserve said in its report, using U.S. President Trump's preferred term for AI. The PBOC added that this enthusiasm has cooled somewhat due to market concerns about corporate capital expenditure and debt issuance plans.

items.title_zh: 纳斯达克100指数跌超1%，标普跌0.4%，半导体指数下跌将近4%

items.title_en: The Nasdaq 100 Index fell by over 1%, the S&P 500 Index fell by 0.4%, and the Semiconductor Index fell by nearly 4%.
items.body_en: Nvidia fell 2.3%, Cerebras' gain narrowed to 11.3%, Google A rose 1.1%, AMD fell 7.6%, CoreWeave fell 9.4%, Nebius fell 10.6%, and SanDisk fell 6.1%. Investors are weighing the chip sector against U.S. PPI inflation data.

items.title_zh: 英国央行首席经济学家：明年或需进一步加息，伊朗冲突结束可能性极低
items.body_zh: 英国央行首席经济学家皮尔（Huw Pill）在周六刊出的采访中表示，为抑制通胀，英国央行除了12月下次会议加息之外，2027年可能需要进一步加息。
items.title_en: Bank of England Chief Economist: Further interest rate hikes may be needed next year, and the likelihood of the Iran conflict ending is extremely low.
items.body_en: In an interview published on Saturday, Huw Pill, Chief Economist of the Bank of England, stated that to curb inflation, the Bank of England may need to raise interest rates further in 2027, in addition to the rate hike at its next meeting in December.

items.title_zh: 何立峰出席亚太经合组织工商咨询理事会第四次会议开幕式并致辞
items.body_zh: 11月14日，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰在深圳出席亚太经合组织（APEC）工商咨询理事会第四次会议开幕式并致辞。何立峰指出，亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议即将在深圳举行，为亚太合作明确方向、凝聚力量。希望工商咨询理事会继续发扬开拓进取、开放创新的企业家精神，推动APEC向着构建亚太共同体目标再启航，为亚太区域协同合作、创新发展、互联互通做出新的贡献。
items.title_en: He Lifeng Attends the Opening Ceremony of the Fourth Meeting of the APEC Business Advisory Council and Delivers a Speech.
items.body_en: On November 14, He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended the opening ceremony of the Fourth Meeting of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Business Advisory Council in Shenzhen and delivered a speech. He Lifeng pointed out that the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting is set to take place in Shenzhen, providing clear direction and rallying support for cooperation in the Asia-Pacific region. It is hoped that the Business Advisory Council will continue to foster an entrepreneurial spirit of pioneering progress, openness, and innovation, propelling APEC forward once again toward the goal of building an Asia-Pacific community and making new contributions to collaboration, innovative development, and connectivity within the Asia-Pacific region.

items.title_zh: 美联储副主席Jefferson：通胀将决定利率决策
items.body_zh: 美联储副主席Philip Jefferson表示，在考虑进一步加息时，通胀已成为政策制定者最重要的衡量指标。近期美国经济活动和劳动力市场状况一直稳健，但价格压力依然顽固，10月份的物价数据与远高于目标的通胀水平相一致。货币政策可以影响周期性状况，但无法解决决定长期就业率的结构性因素，例如工人技能与雇主需求之间的错配。
items.title_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Jefferson: Inflation will determine interest rate decisions.
items.body_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson stated that inflation has become the most important metric for policymakers when considering further interest rate hikes. Recently, U.S. economic activity and labor market conditions have remained robust, but price pressures persist. October's price data aligns with inflation levels well above the target. Monetary policy can influence cyclical conditions, but it cannot address the structural factors that determine long-term employment rates, such as the mismatch between workers' skills and employers' needs.

items.title_zh: 美联储柯林斯：稳步、渐进加息是适宜之举
items.body_zh: 波士顿联储行长苏珊·柯林斯表示，随着劳动力市场站稳脚跟而没有加剧价格压力，循序渐进的加息路径对于降低通胀来说将是适宜的。
items.title_en: Federal Reserve's Collins: Steady, gradual interest rate hikes are appropriate.
items.body_en: Boston Fed President Susan Collins said that a gradual path of rate hikes would be appropriate to bring down inflation as the labor market stabilizes without adding to price pressures.

items.title_zh: 摩根士丹利财富管理Shalett：AI资本支出驱动的牛市逻辑依然稳固
items.body_zh: 英伟达公司领导层的动荡以及民主党在中期选举中获胜，加剧了市场对人工智能热潮的担忧，但摩根士丹利财富管理的Lisa Shalett表示，这些因素不会动摇本轮牛市的主要驱动力...
items.title_en: Shalett of Morgan Stanley Wealth Management: The bull market logic driven by AI capital expenditure remains solid.
items.body_en: The turmoil in Nvidia's leadership and the Democrats' victory in the midterm elections have heightened market concerns about the AI boom. However, Lisa Shalett of Morgan Stanley Wealth Management states that these factors will not undermine the main drivers of this bull market...

items.title_zh: 美财长承认移居军事基地，斥责《华尔街日报》泄露住址信息
items.body_zh: 据美国消费者新闻与商业频道（CNBC）13日报道，美国财政部长贝森特当天在接受该媒体采访时承认自己已从住所搬至一处军事基地，并称搬家的原因之一是美国《华尔街日报》刊登了一张其住所照片，上面包含地理位置信息。
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary acknowledges relocation to military base, criticizes The Wall Street Journal for leaking address information.
items.body_en: According to a report by the U.S. Consumer News and Business Channel (CNBC) on the 13th, U.S. Secretary of the Treasury Janet Yellen admitted in an interview with the media that day that she had moved from her residence to a military base, stating that one of the reasons for the move was the publication by The Wall Street Journal of a photo of her residence, which included geographical location information.

items.title_zh: 高质量数据集和数据标注先行先试现场会在厦门市召开
items.body_zh: 国家数据局消息，11月10日下午，高质量数据集和数据标注先行先试建设现场会在厦门市召开。会议强调，国家数据局将深入贯彻落实党中央、国务院关于人工智能发展的决策部署，加快推进高质量数据集建设和数据标注产业发展。
items.title_en: Pilot Program for High-Quality Datasets and Data Annotation Held in Xiamen.
items.body_en: According to the National Data Administration, an on-site meeting for the pilot construction of high-quality datasets and data annotation was held in Xiamen City on the afternoon of November 10. The meeting emphasized that the National Data Administration will thoroughly implement the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council regarding the development of artificial intelligence, and accelerate the development of high-quality datasets and the data annotation industry.

items.title_zh: 中美举行中美经贸磋商机制项下贸易理事会首次会议
items.body_zh: 11月13日，中美双方通过视频会议方式举行中美经贸磋商机制项下贸易理事会首次会议。双方以中美元首会晤重要共识为引领，围绕落实前期中美经贸磋商成果，就关税、“300亿对300亿”对等降税安排、农产品贸易以及各自关心的其他议题进行了坦诚、深入、建设性的交流。
items.title_en: China and the United States Hold the First Meeting of the Trade Council Under the China–U.S. Economic and Trade Consultation Mechanism.
items.body_en: On November 13, China and the United States held the first meeting of the Trade Council under the China–U.S. Economic and Trade Consultation Mechanism via video conference. Guided by the key consensus reached at the China-U.S. Summit, and with a focus on implementing the outcomes of previous China-U.S. economic and trade consultations, both sides engaged in candid, in-depth, and constructive discussions on tariffs, the "30 billion to 30 billion" reciprocal tariff reduction arrangement, agricultural trade, and other issues of mutual concern.

items.title_zh: 特朗普下周访问亚洲 被曝会带马斯克 回避提及英伟达、黄仁勋
items.body_zh: 据美联社报道，美国总统特朗普计划下周访问亚洲时带上马斯克。匿名政府官员透露，作为SpaceX和特斯拉的掌门人，马斯克在经济和国家安全方面拥有重要利益，这使他成为特朗普的宝贵顾问。官员还透露，特朗普并不打算提及黄仁勋相关事件，美国政府认为英伟达事件不会对此次访问产生任何影响。
items.title_en: It has been reported that Trump will bring Musk with him on his visit to Asia next week, and will avoid mentioning Nvidia and Jensen Huang.
items.body_en: According to the Associated Press, U.S. President Trump plans to take Musk with him on his visit to Asia next week. Anonymous government officials revealed that, as the head of SpaceX and Tesla, Musk has significant interests in both the economy and national security, making him a valuable advisor to Trump. The official also revealed that Trump does not intend to mention the incident involving Jensen Huang, and the U.S. government believes that the Nvidia incident will not have any impact on this visit.

items.title_zh: 财政部：通过“先旧后新”配售开展融资，大股东通过同一离岸信托卖出和买入股票，
items.body_zh: 财政部：通过“先旧后新”配售开展融资，大股东通过同一离岸信托卖出和买入股票，价格完全一致，且在配售协议签署之日起14日内将新股发行给大股东同一离岸信托的，其卖出股票数量不超过买入股票数量的部分，可不视为转让信托财产，不调整股票财产原值。
items.title_en: The Ministry of Finance: Financing is carried out through a "first-in, first-out" placement, where major shareholders sell and buy shares through the same offshore trust.
items.body_en: The Ministry of Finance: If financing is carried out through a "first-old, then-new" placement, and the majority shareholder sells and buys shares through the same offshore trust at exactly the same price, and the new shares are issued to the same offshore trust of the majority shareholder within 14 days from the date of signing the placement agreement, the portion of the shares sold that does not exceed the number of shares purchased may not be considered as a transfer of trust property, and the original value of the share property shall not be adjusted.

items.title_zh: 美国CFTC计划对美国的铝价机制进行全面改革
items.body_zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）主席塞利格（Michael Selig）周五表示，该委员会正计划对美国的铝价机制进行全面改革，并探讨新合约能否提高市场透明度。受中东战争引发的供应短缺影响，伦敦金属交易所（LME）铝价升至3,700美元以上的四年高点，这使得美国消费者面临的总成本超过每吨6,000美元。
items.title_en: The U.S. CFTC plans a comprehensive reform of the U.S. aluminum pricing mechanism.
items.body_en: On Friday, Michael Selig, Chairman of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), stated that the commission is planning a comprehensive overhaul of the U.S. aluminum pricing mechanism and is exploring whether new contracts could enhance market transparency. Due to supply shortages caused by the war in the Middle East, aluminum prices on the London Metal Exchange (LME) have risen to a four-year high of over $3,700, resulting in a total cost of more than $6,000 per ton for U.S. consumers.

story.era: 美国 · 伯克希尔副手
story.title_zh: 倒过来想，总是倒过来想
story.body_zh: 芒格不喜欢问怎么成功，他喜欢问怎么失败。有人问他怎么把投资做好，他说：先列出所有让人亏钱的方法，然后一辈子别碰。巴菲特说，是芒格把他从捡烟蒂变成了买好公司。
story.body_en: Charlie Munger rarely asked how to succeed. He asked how to fail. List every way to lose money, then avoid all of it, forever. Buffett said Munger moved him from cheap stocks to great businesses.

lines.en: Every year, thousands of investors make the pilgrimage to Omaha. Most of them come for two men, not one.
lines.zh: 每年都有成千上万的投资者去奥马哈朝圣。他们大多是为两个人来的，不是一个人。

lines.en: Mr. Munger, how do I become a great investor?
lines.zh: 芒格先生，我怎样才能成为优秀的投资者？

lines.en: Wrong question. Ask me how to be a terrible one.
lines.zh: 问题就问错了。你应该问我，怎么变成一个糟糕的投资者。

lines.en: All right then. How do I lose all my money?
lines.zh: 行吧，那我怎么才能把钱全亏光？

lines.en: Easy. Use leverage. Chase rumors. Buy what is hot. Pretend you understand. Then avoid all of it, forever.
lines.zh: 太简单了。加杠杆、听消息、追热门、不懂装懂。然后一辈子都别碰这些。

lines.en: Buffett once said Munger pushed him from cheap stocks to wonderful businesses. Cheap is not enough. A cheap, wonderful business is the goal.
lines.zh: 巴菲特说，是芒格把他从捡烟蒂推向了买好公司。便宜不是终点，便宜的好生意才是。

joke.title_zh: 爱因斯坦说复利是第八大奇迹？
joke.title_en: Did Einstein Call Compounding the Eighth Wonder?
joke.body_zh: 据说爱因斯坦讲过：复利是世界第八大奇迹，懂的人赚它，不懂的人付它。这句话他大概率没说过，却成了金融圈流传最广的名言。真假不重要，道理是真的：时间+利率，是普通人和财富之间最诚实的一条路。反过来也一样，利滚利的债，也会按同样的数学惩罚不守纪律的人。
joke.body_en: People say Einstein once called compound interest the eighth wonder of the world. Those who understand it earn it. Those who do not, pay it. He probably never said it. But the quote refuses to die, because the math is real. Time, plus a steady rate, is the most honest road to wealth for ordinary people. And the road works both ways. Debt compounds too, with the same mathematics, punishing those who break their rules.
